title.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW, 380 V and 5 m by 5 m. Electric 10 prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h and 25 m horizontal, with no voltage cell.
description.zh: B500S-83D 印 7.5 kW、380 V、垂直和水平各 5 m。电动10印 15 kW、21 m³/h、水平 25 m，没有电压格。

h1.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D and Electric 10 Series are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. B500S-83D prints a two-stage type, manual / electric, 7.5 kW, rated voltage 380 V, 5 m vertical, 5 m horizontal and 280 kg. Electric 10 prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and 25 m horizontal, with no vertical line and no voltage.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 和电动10系列是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。B500S-83D 印两级结构、手动/电动、7.5 kW、额定电压 380 V、垂直 5 m、水平 5 m、280 kg。电动10印 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m，没有垂直行，也没有电压。380 V 只属于 B500S-83D 这一页。

heading.en: Where B500S-83D and Electric 10 Series print different values
heading.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW; Electric 10 Series prints 15 kW. Dimensions: B500S-83D prints 915 × 550 × 550 mm; Electric 10 Series prints 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：B500S-83D印 7.5 kW；电动10系列印 15 kW。外形尺寸：B500S-83D印 915 × 550 × 550 mm；电动10系列印 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: B500S-83D prints cells that Electric 10 Series does not: Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric; Rated voltage 380 V; Vertical delivery height 5 m; Horizontal delivery distance 5 m; Boom line Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Electric 10 Series prints cells that B500S-83D does not: Theoretical output 21 m³/h; Max. outlet pressure 23 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.1 m³; Horizontal pumping distance 25 m; Max. aggregate size 2 cm and below. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: B500S-83D有、电动10系列没有的行：型式 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric；额定电压 380 V；垂直输送高度 5 m；水平输送距离 5 m；臂架行 Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom。电动10系列有、B500S-83D没有的行：理论输送量 21 m³/h；最大出口压力 23 MPa；料斗容积 0.1 m³；水平输送距离 25 m；最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Do not paste the only published 380 V rating onto the Electric 10 row. Open /en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/ for B500S-83D and /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 不要把目录里唯一印出的 380 V 贴到电动10这一行。看B500S-83D请打开 /zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/，看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does B500S-83D print the same motor power as Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 7.5 kW. Electric 10 Series prints 15 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D印 7.5 kW。电动10系列印 15 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does B500S-83D print the same dimensions as Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动10系列的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D prints 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 10 Series prints 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D印 915 × 550 × 550 mm。电动10系列印 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is type missing on Electric 10 Series?
question.zh: 为什么电动10系列没有型式？

answer.en: The Electric 10 Series page does not print that label. B500S-83D prints Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动10系列这一页没有印这个标题。B500S-83D印的是 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

question.en: Where is the theoretical output for Electric 10 Series printed?
question.zh: 电动10系列的理论输送量印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ as 21 m³/h. It is not printed as that label on the B500S-83D page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，数值为 21 m³/h。B500S-83D页面没有这个标题。
